title: Message them on WhatsApp
summary: More actions → WhatsApp: opens WhatsApp with the patient's number and your message.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: WhatsApp
steps.details: It only shows if the patient (or their responsible contact) has a phone.

steps.title: Phone
steps.details: The patient's or their responsible contact's.

steps.title: Open WhatsApp
steps.details: Opens WhatsApp Web or the app with the message ready to send.
